subject: Apply a vintage 1970s photochemical LUT. See .rundeer/luts/vintage_70s.md for the full LUT specification. Lift blacks to a warm dark brown (characteristic of aged C-41 processing), introduce strong faded highlights with a greenish-yellow cast, push skin tones toward orange-amber, desaturate blues and cyans, add a subtle halation around light sources, and introduce slight color banding in smooth gradients to simulate aging photographic printing. Preserve all composition and subject identity.
